confirmed: The source is the 25-page arXiv:2502.16062v1 [cs.HC], dated 22 Feb 2025; its title and all listed authors match the form. The appendices were read with the main text; the CHI version of record was not used (p. 1, title/authors and arXiv stamp; pp. 20-25, Appendices A-D).

The evaluation contains 24 people, each using both systems, rather than 24 independent people per arm; no assigned-randomly count or exclusions are reported. Recruitment states 12 female and 12 male participants aged 20-31 (Mean = 24.08, SD = 3.31), local university students/faculty equally divided between computer science and design; paired t(23) results support 24 analyzed pairs, below the 50-person threshold (p. 10, Sections 6.1-6.2; pp. 12-13, Sections 6.3.3-6.3.5).

Creative Blends uses GPT-3.5-turbo and ConceptNet, with DALL-E 3 for images; the baseline is ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 with DALL-E 3) plus Google Search. This is a comparison of AI configurations, with no AI-free arm (p. 7, Section 4.3.1; p. 8, Section 4.3.3; pp. 9-10, Sections 6 and 6.2).

The two task expressions match the form. Each condition begins with a 4-minute tutorial and permits 8 minutes of design work; the whole experiment lasts no more than 60 minutes. Task/system order is counterbalanced through a Latin square, with no statement that people or sequences were randomized (p. 9, Figure 6; p. 10, Section 6.2).

S1-O1 reported numbers match: Creative Blends 5.655 (SD 0.974), baseline 5.047 (SD 1.193), Table 1 t = 2.276 and p = 0.032; prose t(23) = -2.276 and Cohen's d = 0.558. The form correctly preserves the table/prose sign difference (p. 11, Table 1; p. 13, Section 6.3.5).

S1-O2 reported numbers match: diversity satisfaction 5.380 (SD 1.345) versus 3.670 (SD 1.274), Table 1 t = 5.058, p < 0.001; prose t(23) = -5.058, d = 1.305. Overall satisfaction is 5.080 (SD 1.283) versus 3.960 (SD 1.367), Table 1 t = 2.609, p = 0.016 (p. 11, Table 1; p. 12, Section 6.3.3).

S1-O3 reported numbers match: exploration 5.708 (SD 1.160) versus 4.083 (SD 1.886), Table 1 t = 2.985, p = 0.007; prose t(23) = -2.985, d = 1.038. Expressiveness is 5.167 (SD 1.167) versus 4.375 (SD 1.689), Table 1 t = 1.807, p = 0.084 (p. 11, Table 1; p. 12, Section 6.3.4).

The one-line finding accurately reports the sample, arm means and p values and identifies them as self-reports. Metaphoricity is explicitly a 7-point participant rating from no metaphor to extremely strong metaphor (p. 11, Table 1; p. 13, Section 6.3.5; p. 24, Appendix C.3).

No qualifying output-scored creativity or across-person diversity outcome is reported: CSI measures perceived process support, diversity measures satisfaction, and metaphoricity is rated by participants themselves. CLIP similarity is a feature of the design tool, not a measured comparison across participants' outputs. Core = no, criterion_2 = not_met, criterion_3 = not_met and context_class = none remain supported (pp. 7-8, Section 4.3.2; pp. 10-13, Section 6.3; p. 24, Appendix C).

This is a system-development and user-evaluation paper, not a synthesis; there are no pooled estimates, intervals or standardizers to extract. The synthesis defaults are appropriate (p. 1, Abstract; pp. 4-5, Section 3; pp. 9-13, Section 6; p. 17, Conclusion).
summary: The arXiv v1 paper reports a 24-person counterbalanced comparison of two AI configurations, without stated random assignment or a qualifying creativity/diversity outcome. The reported statistics and core exclusion are supported, but the RCT label, supplement status, outcome documentation, omitted formative study, and several form details require correction.
